title: Airy Delicate Japanese Kidney Beans Nabemono
description: A cultured and light Japanese dish featuring kidney beans in a nabemono style, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe is friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences.
instructions: In a large pot, combine dashi broth, mirin, and soy sauce, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the kidney beans, cooking for 10 minutes or until they are tender.
In a small pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and fry the tofu until it is golden brown.
Add the fried tofu to the pot with the kidney beans and stir to combine.
In a separate pan, heat a small amount of sesame oil over medium heat and fry the wonton wrappers until they are crispy and puffed.
Add the green onions, salt, and white pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
To serve, place a portion of the kidney bean mixture into a bowl and top with a piece of the crispy wonton wrapper.
Garnish with additional green onions if desired.
